description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InteropAccountNotFoundException' used in the Fineract project to indicate that an interoperation account was not found. It extends a base exception class and constructs an error message based on identifier type and value.

classes.name: InteropAccountNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating that an interoperation account was not found, extending AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException.

methods.name: InteropAccountNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message based on provided identifier type, value, and optional sub-identifier or type.
